fields.sampleId: Stable local id for this research outcome sample.
fields.strategyVersion: AlphaPilot strategy or research report version that produced the candidate.
fields.candidatePoolId: Pool/rule id used for the candidate.
fields.signalTime: UTC ISO timestamp for candidate generation.
fields.entryTime: UTC ISO timestamp for simulated or reviewed entry if available.
fields.exitTime: UTC ISO timestamp for simulated or reviewed exit if available.
fields.factorSnapshot: Point-in-time learned factor values and factor ranks.
fields.riskSnapshot: Risk context, liquidity context, fees, slippage assumptions, and exposure limits.
fields.outcome: Win/loss, netReturnPct, rMultiple, exitReason, drawdown, holdingBars, and review notes.
fields.humanReview: Optional user review: accepted, rejected, skipped, mistake tags, notes.
fields.createdAt: UTC ISO timestamp when the local sample record was written.

promotionRule: Samples can improve future research only after offline validation. They must never trigger automatic order creation or bypass safety gates.
